capabilities: manage kanban boards stored as markdown notes in the vault
switch the same cards between board, table, and list views
parse inline tokens (due dates, tags, priorities, recurrence) into chips
filter and roll up cards with saved views and a dashboard
sync cards with GitHub Issues and export dated cards to .ics
extras: Freemium: free core board features, Pro tier at $5.99 lifetime. The listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Pre-release builds available via BRAT (icarian-systems/kanban-pro-plugin).
intentEvidence: reads and writes the same kanban-plugin: board markdown format used by the community Kanban plugin
problem: Obsidian has no built-in project board, so planning work as drag-and-drop cards over plain markdown files requires a plugin.

relations.evidence: reads and writes the same kanban-plugin: board markdown format used by the community Kanban plugin
other plugins (Dataview, Tasks) keep working too
also recognizes the broader Tasks plugin emoji set
GitHub Issues sync and Calendar (.ics) export (both Pro)

requires.name: Pro license ($5.99 lifetime) for Saved Views, Dashboard, recurrence, time tracking, GitHub sync and .ics export

summary: Local-first Kanban board plugin that stores boards as plain markdown and shows the same cards as board, table, list, or dashboard views.
